mainEntity.name: How quickly can a 30-day training contract or consulting sprint begin?

acceptedAnswer.text: Scoping audits and technical intake begin within 3 to 5 business days of scope approval. Comprehensive 30-day workforce training sprints and dedicated advisory retainers are scheduled based on current sprint cohort capacity.

mainEntity.name: What does the training contract look like in practice?

acceptedAnswer.text: The contract spans 30 calendar days (4 intensive weekly milestones) of hands-on architectural and coding immersion: Week 1 (Days 1-7) Architectural Assessment, Toolchains & Sandboxes; Week 2 (Days 8-15) Agent Orchestration, Skills & MCP Servers; Week 3 (Days 16-22) Local LLM Clusters, OpenCode & AI-Assisted TDD; Week 4 (Days 23-30) Hard Budget Governance, Automated Evals & IP Handover. Concludes with 30 days of included support.

mainEntity.name: How do you guarantee code quality and prevent AI hallucinations?

acceptedAnswer.text: Strict Test-Driven Development (TDD) with AI: every API connector, agent tool loop, local LLM pipeline, and quantum circuit is runtime-verified in isolated execution environments (pytest, cargo test, and Qiskit simulators) with failing test suites written first before code generation.

mainEntity.name: Who owns the intellectual property (IP) and custom training assets?

acceptedAnswer.text: You retain 100% complete IP ownership and commercial copyright upon milestone payment completion. All custom agent state machines, tool harnesses, local model configurations, and training assets are transferred directly under your organization's proprietary license.

mainEntity.name: What post-engagement support and updates are included?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every engagement includes 30 days of active Discord or Slack channel access for direct developer advisory and troubleshooting, plus 60 days of free minor curriculum adjustments, sample code guide updates, and upstream model breaking-change fixes.

mainEntity.name: How does the 6-Tier Purchasing Power Parity (PPP) pricing model work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard engagement fees are indexed across 6 Purchasing Power Parity (PPP) tiers covering 195 countries: Tier 1 Developed (100%), Tier 2 Developing (75%), Tier 3 Emerging (50%), Tier 4 Early-Stage Startups (50% off), Tier 5 Non-Profits & Academia (75% off), and Tier 6 Global Equity & Underprivileged Nations (custom subsidized quotes).
